title: Contra Verve
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 8 "larks pass by right shoulders to reform circle on the other side of set" isn't drawn yet.

Row 3 "partners balance & swing end swing in wave of 4 , from stage the larks on left is facing down his partner is facing up the larks on the right is facing up his partner is facing down, they release swing hands and step left larks take partner right hand robins take left hands in center of wave of 4 everyone is back to where they started! · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.

choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
